name: Change Approval Required
description: A change requires an approved decision from the Change Evaluation and Scheduling Service, confirmed non-conflicting with concurrently scheduled changes, with a documented rollback plan.

conditions.statement: Change request has an associated approved decision from the Change Evaluation and Scheduling Service.

requiredEvidence.title: Change Approval Record
requiredEvidence.description: Change request has an associated approved decision from the Change Evaluation and Scheduling Service.

exceptionRules.exceptionStatement: Emergency change may proceed with retrospective approval within one business day, per Authority policy.
exceptionRules.reviewRequirements: Retrospective approval must be recorded within one business day of the change.

conditions.statement: The change does not conflict with another approved change scheduled for the same window.

requiredEvidence.title: Change Conflict Report
requiredEvidence.description: The change does not conflict with another approved change scheduled for the same window.

conditions.statement: The change includes a documented rollback plan (satisfies O3 where the change is itself a release).

requiredEvidence.title: Rollback Procedure Document
requiredEvidence.description: The change includes a documented rollback plan (satisfies O3 where the change is itself a release).
